propositions: The documented curl command to install the commit-msg hook resolves to the shared hooks directory instead of the worktree-specific location, silently clobbering the pre-commit wrapper across all worktrees on the host.

Running the documented hook install from a linked worktree overwrites the shared pre-commit wrapper in the main checkout, breaking Change-Id stamping and the 50/72 message gate until repair, with silent failure until git push gerrit rejects the commit.
The failure is invisible at commit time and surfaces only at push in a potentially different worktree, making it difficult to correlate cause and effect across multiple contributors.

The fix consolidates hook installation into make hooks with a worktree-safe install script that detects pre-commit wrappers and installs the Gerrit stamper to commit-msg.legacy instead, refusing unsafe overwrites with clear error messages.
